system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudWatch Dashboard for Lambda-based API health monitoring'

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function to monitor
    Default: my-api-lambda-function

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Default: LambdaAPIHealthDashboard

Resources:
  LambdaAPIDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "widgets": [
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 0,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 300,
                    "stat": "Sum",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Lambda Invocations (Sum, 5-min intervals)",
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "stacked": false
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 12,
                  "y": 0,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 300,
                    "stat": "Sum",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Lambda Errors (Sum, 5-min intervals)",
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "stacked": false
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 6,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "AWS/Lambda", "Throttles", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 300,
                    "stat": "Sum",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Lambda Throttles (Sum, 5-min intervals)",
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "stacked": false
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 12,
                  "y": 6,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300 } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 300,
                    "stat": "Average",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Lambda Average Duration (ms, 5-min intervals)",
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "stacked": false
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - LambdaFunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
